scientific_integrity: Analytic proofs supply the all-size statements. Standalone finite enumeration and exact algebraic comparisons are reproducibility checks, not independent validation or a proof of historical priority.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to equally weighted symmetric nearest-neighbor bridges and the Chung–Feller midpoint-positive convention; the finite conditional distribution and general nonbridge analogues are not classified. Earlier general path generating functions might implicitly contain the formulas.
title: A sharp return-count profile across Chung–Feller occupations of a random-walk bridge
